name: autoform
description: Plan, prove, and review Lean formalizations as Markdown graphs with Lean LSP and REPL tools.

interface.shortDescription: Lean planning, review, LSP, and REPL
interface.longDescription: AutoForm keeps a Lean formalization plan as a linked Markdown wiki, checks the work through dedicated Lean LSP and REPL servers, and reviews faithfulness, proof integrity, and Mathlib style.
defaultPrompt: Create an Autoform Markdown blueprint from my sources.
Work through the ready nodes in my Autoform blueprint.
Review this Lean formalization against its source and proof chain.
